Zombie
City

An endless quarantine zone: burning streets, ruins, ash towns, suburbs, deserts and the frozen north, with rivers, storms and seasons. Zombie City 2.0 is rebuilding its 1,000 zombies: the first 50 are here, each with its own look, behaviour and 50 animations, and guns that hit like real ones. Survive the waves and collect 250 weapons. Tune the radio to FM 66.6: seven channels, 245 songs, or your own music.

Drag on the left side to move. Your gun aims and fires on its own. Tap the right side to dash.

Options

Settings

Ultra advanced · Accessibility

Engine room

Every engine in the game, live. What each one costs, what it is doing, how intricate it is, and how hard it runs.

Ultra advanced

!Warning

This will affect performance and cause other issues. The self-adaptive system and repairable ecosystem these engines have will fix itself for your convenience.

  • What you can change. How hard each engine runs (Auto, Eco, Normal, Hard, Max) and what it runs on (CPU, GPU or Auto). Your choice overrides what the game would pick for your device.
  • What can go wrong. A lower frame rate, a hotter device and a faster-draining battery, stutter in big fights, and on some devices an engine that fails and has to rest.
  • How it fixes itself. If a choice keeps the game well under its frame-rate target for 8 seconds, or the engine keeps failing, the ecosystem puts it back on Auto for 5 minutes and shows Auto-lock in purple with the reason. Engines that cannot do something are locked the same way.
  • Going back. "Everything back to Auto" in the engine room undoes it all at once.

Radio & sound

FM 66.6

Every song is made by the game, so no two channels sound alike. Bluetooth plays music files from your device.

Wi-Fi co-op

Play together

Up to four players on the same Wi-Fi fight the same waves and bosses. One PC hosts; phones (the Android app) and other PCs join. Everyone moves and shoots for themselves, the score is shared, and a player who goes down can be revived by a teammate standing next to them.

Host a game

Join a game

DeclAIre Studios

Your account

One free account for every version of Zombie City: the website, the Android app and the Windows launcher. It saves your weapons, dashes, specimens, bosses and record to the cloud so they follow you to every device, and it puts your name on the global board. Your save is encrypted with a key that only your password can open, so nobody else can read it. Not even us.
